description_en: Attaches a network ACL to a vSwitch
description_zh: 调用AssociateNetworkAcl接口，绑定网络ACL到交换机
kebab_example: aliyun vpc associate-network-acl --network-acl-id nacl-a2do9e413e0sp0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateNetworkAcl

fields.help_en: The ID of the associated resource
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the associated resource. Valid values: VSwitch.

Valid values of N: 0 to 29. You can associate up to 30 resources
fields.help_zh:
关联资源的类型。取值：VSwitch，交换机。

N的取值为0~29，即最多可以关联30个资源
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The information about the associated resources
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network ACL
parameters.name: network_acl_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the network ACL. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 网络ACL所在的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run.
false (default): sends the request
parameters.help_zh:
是否检测此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run
